records.name: Internet Policy Review
records.publisher: Alexander von Humboldt Institute for Internet and Society and Center for Advanced Internet Studies, with partners
records.scope_notes: Internet regulation, technology governance and socio-technical change. Empirical, legal, theoretical and documentary analysis can fit; research papers must engage European policy and contribute original critical analysis. This record covers externally peer-reviewed research papers.

route.conditions: Official author policy explicitly excludes submission fees and APCs. Research submissions remain invited, but an October 2026 notice warns of delayed desk screening. Op-ed proposals are closed through the end of 2026 and are not the peer-reviewed route. Initial research manuscripts should be about 6,000 words; the final maximum is 8,000, excluding abstract/references. Generative-AI article authorship is prohibited; inspect the linked full AI policy before preparing work.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No compulsory additional standard-article charge stated in the inspected author policy.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific policy rules out both submission charges and APCs, distinguishes research from op-eds, and reports current submission delays/closure by format.

difficulty.basis: Expansion research establishes no acceptance rate or difficulty ranking.

records.name: Journal of Deliberative Democracy
records.scope_notes: Deliberative and participatory democracy, citizen engagement and democratic governance. Existing-data studies, comparative analysis and theory can fit when they advance deliberative-democracy scholarship. Research articles and Reflections from the Field receive peer review; the associated Digest is a separate non-peer-reviewed publication.

route.conditions: Publisher and sponsors cover publication charges; institutional support is encouraged, not required. The editors' July 2026 statement explicitly excludes author fees at every stage. Public research submissions are enabled. Research articles are 6,000-8,000 words inclusive; Reflections are 2,000-4,000. Special Features are solicited; special issues and book reviews are no longer considered. Third-party permissions remain the author's responsibility.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None under the stated author-fee policy; avoid content requiring paid reuse permission.

fee_evidence.note: Publication Fees says the press/sponsors pay APCs, leaving no author-facing publication fee. The section table enables public submissions for research articles and Reflections.
On the journal's own Digest, editors describe diamond funding and explicitly rule out author fees at every stage of publication.

difficulty.basis: Expansion research establishes no acceptance rate or difficulty ranking; limited publication capacity is not acceptance probability.

records.name: Commonwealth Journal of Local Governance
records.publisher: UTS ePRESS / UTS Centre for Local Government, University of Technology Sydney
records.scope_notes: Local governance, decentralisation, municipal finance, citizen participation, intergovernmental relations and public-service performance, especially Commonwealth contexts. Existing-data evaluation, comparative case analysis and critical literature reviews can fit. This record covers the peer-reviewed Research and Evaluation route; shorter edited/practitioner content has a different review status.

route.conditions: Journal-specific homepage, editorial policy and submission instructions explicitly exclude all types of submission charge and APC. Submission page provides registration/login and invites papers, case studies and literature reviews. Peer-reviewed manuscripts are typically 6,000-8,000 words including references/notes. No closed-submission notice was found in the inspected pages.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No mandatory membership, registration or standard page charge stated in the inspected journal policies.

fee_evidence.note: Author guidelines expressly exclude every type of submission charge and APC and distinguish peer-reviewed from edited content.
Journal-specific open-access policy also excludes submission/APC charges; section policies identify Research and Evaluation as open to submissions and peer-reviewed.

difficulty.basis: Expansion research establishes no acceptance rate or difficulty ranking.

records.name: Policy Quarterly
records.publisher: School of Government, Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington
records.scope_notes: Governance, public policy and public management, written for public-sector practitioners and other policy readers. Concise existing-data analysis, evaluations and policy arguments can fit; New Zealand relevance is prominent in published content. Submitted articles receive peer review, while occasional published major speeches can bypass it.

route.conditions: Official ethics policy excludes manuscript-processing charges and both submission and publication fees. The submission page invites articles of about 4,000 words on governance, public policy or management through its website. No closure notice was present in the inspected author and journal pages. Fees do not depend on affiliation or a selective waiver.

fee_evidence.note: Publication and Submission fee section excludes author processing, submission and publication charges; the same policy describes normal external peer review and the speech exception.

difficulty.basis: Expansion research establishes no acceptance rate or difficulty ranking.

notes: Four additional diamond journals, with no duplicates of public-policy discovery or other saved venue names found during the final duplicate search. No repository/preprint route was added. Scope mappings are candidate fits, not manuscript acceptance decisions.

Current format/availability limits matter: Internet Policy Review research remains invited with delayed screening, but op-eds are closed through 2026; Journal of Deliberative Democracy no longer accepts special issues or book reviews. Article-level review exceptions are retained above.

Excluded European Journal of Government and Economics because it is already captured in research/diamond/economics.json. Its official no-submission-fee/no-APC policy was verified at https://revistas.udc.es/index.php/ejge/information/authors .

Excluded Revue Gouvernance / Governance Review: its official hosted editorial/author policy says manuscript submissions are closed until further notice, despite free OA publication. Source: https://releve.erudit.org/fr/revues/gouvernance/ .

Excluded Central European Journal of Public Policy from verified-free additions: the current publisher page lists a EUR 400 APC while retaining contradictory older no-submission/publication-fee text. Current journal/publisher transfer and fee applicability need resolution. Source: https://reference-global.com/journal/CEJPP .

Central European Public Administration Review remains an unrecorded lead: University of Ljubljana journal policy pages returned HTTP 403, so current submission availability was not established. Official issue material carries strong no-fee wording, but is insufficient here to resolve live author instructions. Sources: https://journals.uni-lj.si/CEPAR/about/submissions ; https://dlib.si/stream/URN%3ANBN%3ASI%3ADOC-DMBUMUU1/ca6733f7-37fb-4c14-8f4d-93e9d3d7502d/PDF .

Official author/publisher material was checked live on 2026-11-16. No impact metric, acceptance probability, prestige ranking or guaranteed turnaround is asserted. This is the expansion role pending independent fee, ranking and skeptical review; no venue was contacted and nothing was submitted.
